attributes.input: Explain data drift to a product manager in at most 50 words, including one concrete example.
attributes.output: Data drift happens when the data your model sees in production gradually stops looking like the data it was trained on. Because machine learning models learn statistical patterns from historical training data, any shift in input distributions, user behaviour, seasonality or upstream pipelines can silently reduce accuracy over time, which is why teams monitor feature distributions and retrain models regularly.
